payload.content: When the question references a name, label, or descriptive phrase that may not appear verbatim in the data, prefer LIKE with wildcards over strict equality. Do not reject a candidate column just because the literal value the user said might differ in casing, whitespace, or punctuation from how it is stored.

rationale: creative; nudges the model to commit to a match even under surface-form variation, rather than abstaining or producing an over-strict equality predicate.
